text:
Alex Kim: quick handoff from evening — we had a KV-cache eviction spike starting ~18:12 UTC, correlated with a batching backlog on the embedding workers. p95 token latency rose from ~110ms to ~850ms, some customers saw 429s for embedding requests. paging happened.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT 2453 triggered — high embedding latency / kv-cache-evictions (auto-page: @alex @mira).

Alex Kim: what we did: scaled kv-cache pool +2 nodes (autoscaler temporarily disabled), toggled batching backpressure to conservative, and enabled fallback routing for high-latency routes to smaller-quantized model (gpt-embed-lite).

Mira Patel: confirmed fallback routing is active (checked traces). most 429s stopped after fallback — current 5xx shows mostly 502s from one edge cluster that's still draining.

Sanjay Rao: I patched the autoscaler policy (minUnreadyThreshold -> 0.15) and restarted controller; it should avoid oscillation for the next 30m. I pushed a canary to 2 pods only.

Riley Chen: noticed one node in eu-west had disk pressure causing kube-eviction noise. I cordoned the node and moved pods. logs: ```kubectl describe node ip-10-2-7-3 | grep -i pressure``` shows DiskPressure true until we drained.

Alex Kim: customer impact: limited to embedding endpoints for ~18:12–18:28 UTC, ~6% requests were 429/502 at peak. Major customers on dedicated capacity unaffected. SLO error budget small for embeddings; notify SRE and CS.

Mira Patel: current status: latency p95 back to ~150ms, kv-cache eviction rate low but still higher than baseline. no new pages in last 12m.

Alex Kim: runbook pointers: /runbook/kv-cache-eviction (internal) — follow "mitigate -> scale -> fallback" steps. autoscaler doc: https://confluence.redwood.com/ops/autoscaler-policies.

Sanjay Rao: follow-ups I'm filing: OPS-1219 (investigate disk thrash on eu-west), OPS-1220 (autoscaler tuning regression test), OPS-1221 (improve fallback metrics to alert earlier).

Riley Chen: FYI command to check eviction histograms: ```curl -s http://metrics.internal/api/kv/evictions?window=5m | jq .p95``` — output looked like `0.18` at peak (fraction of requests evicted).

Mira Patel: next steps for next shift: keep autoscaler at conservative settings until OPS-1220 is done, monitor p95 < 200ms and 5xx < 0.5% for embeddings. escalate to infra if node pressure returns.

Alex Kim: coverage for next 12h: Mira primary, Sanjay secondary. Riley will be regional contact for EU node issues. I'll be reachable for the next 30m then offline.

Mira Patel: ack, taking primary. leaving checks: run the two quick commands on handoff: ```kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=kv-cache``` and ```curl -s http://metrics.internal/api/latency?route=embed | jq .p95``` — expect p95 < 200ms.

oncall-bot: pager summary — 3 pages (2 acknowledged) — incident auto-resolved to degraded after mitigation at 18:28 UTC.

Alex Kim: notes for postmortem: call out autoscaler oscillation around 18:10 and EU node disk pressure as contributing factors. assign action owners in ops tickets.

Mira Patel: thanks all. I'll post a short status update to #incidents and ping CS with the customer impact summary. leaving this thread as the canonical handoff. :white_check_mark:
